definition: The most likely of a few Gaussian components fitted to features of the market, read as the regime the latest bar belongs to.
boundaries: Not computed in QML yet: it is fitted to history by numerical optimisation, which belongs in the Lab's training placement; it runs in shadow in the MIS until his yes, behind the same reading shape, so no unit changes when it goes live. The features it is fitted on are a binding's choice and not written here.
recognition: Each component is a regime with its own mean and volatility.

class_meanings.index_cfd: A return across a session close, a weekend or a contract roll is a gap, not a bar's move; bind the statistic to bars inside one session or a back-adjusted series, or it reads the gap.
